usage_rule: Use these clips only for the opening human hook or creator reaction beat. The later proof/demo/result beats must still come from the product-specific footage library.

crop_guidance.default_crop: center crop around Xiaoyu's face and upper body; keep eyes, mouth, and hand gesture visible; leave upper-left or upper-right space for short overlay text when possible
crop_guidance.avoid: Do not crop away the mouth-covering hand, pointing hand, or widened eyes because those are the hook signal.
